# CODM Software

> CODM Software Limited is a UK Salesforce Consulting Partner headquartered in London, with a regional office in Birmingham and delivery teams in the USA and India. We implement Salesforce, build AI and Agentforce solutions, integrate systems and develop custom software.

Key facts:
- Legal name: CODM Software Limited (Companies House 15333870), incorporated 2023-12-07
- Headquarters: 71-75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London WC2H 9JQ, UK; regional office in Birmingham; teams in the USA and India
- Salesforce: Salesforce Consulting Partner
- Accreditations: Salesforce Consulting Partner; G-Cloud 15 supplier (RM1557.15), Lot 3: Cloud Support; Cyber Essentials; Google Cloud Partner; Gearset partner
- Industries: Financial services, Insurance, Healthcare, Higher education, Manufacturing, Nonprofit, Energy and utilities, Retail, Technology, Government and public sector
- Contact: info@codmsoftware.co.uk, +44 121 818 6924

## Services

- [Services](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices): Salesforce implementation (Sales, Service, Financial Services, Education and more), Agentforce and LLM development, integration, software and support.
- [Financial Services Cloud](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/salesforce-financial-services): CODM Software implements Salesforce Financial Services Cloud for banks, wealth managers and insurers: client 360, onboarding, compliance and Agentforce.
- [Education Cloud](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/salesforce-education-cloud): Salesforce Education Cloud implementation for universities and colleges: admissions, student success, advising and Experience Cloud portals.
- [Health & Insurance Cloud](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/salesforce-health-insurance-cloud): Salesforce Health Cloud and Insurance Cloud implementation: patient and policyholder 360, claims, care coordination and secure data management.
- [Sales Cloud](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/salesforce-sales-cloud): Sales Cloud set-up and optimisation by certified consultants: lead and opportunity management, forecasting, automation and reporting.
- [Service Cloud](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/salesforce-service-cloud): Service Cloud implementation: case management, omni-channel routing, knowledge, self-service portals and Agentforce service agents.
- [Marketing Cloud](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/salesforce-marketing-cloud): Marketing Cloud set-up and campaigns: journeys, email and SMS automation, segmentation and personalisation connected to your Salesforce data.
- [Data Cloud](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/salesforce-data-cloud): Salesforce Data Cloud implementation: unify customer data, build real-time segments and ground Agentforce and Einstein AI in trusted data.
- [Nonprofit Cloud](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/salesforce-nonprofit-cloud): Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud implementation for charities and NGOs: donor management, fundraising, programme tracking and impact reporting.
- [Manufacturing Cloud](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/salesforce-manufacturing-cloud): Manufacturing Cloud implementation: sales agreements, account-based forecasting, partner management and connected production data.
- [Energy & Utilities Cloud](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/salesforce-energy-utilities-cloud): Energy & Utilities Cloud implementation for suppliers and utilities: customer service, service points, billing integration and field service.
- [Salesforce CRM Implementation](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/crm-development): End-to-end Salesforce CRM implementation and custom development by certified architects: discovery, build, data migration, training and support.
- [AI & LLM Development](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/building-llm): Production AI built on your own data: Agentforce agents, LLM-powered assistants, document search and workflow automation with security built in.
- [API Integration](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/api-integration): Connect Salesforce with ERP, finance, marketing and legacy systems through secure, monitored REST and SOAP API integrations.
- [Data Integration & Migration](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/data-integration): Plan, cleanse and migrate data into Salesforce with accuracy checks and minimal downtime, then keep systems in sync with reliable integrations.
- [.NET Development](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/dotnet-application-development): Secure, scalable .NET web and enterprise applications built by CODM Software, integrated with Salesforce and your existing systems.
- [React Development](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/react-application-development): Fast, accessible React web applications and portals built by CODM Software, connected to Salesforce and your APIs.
- [Python Development](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/python-application-development): Python applications, data pipelines and AI services built by CODM Software, integrated with Salesforce and cloud platforms.
- [Technical Support](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/technical-support): Ongoing Salesforce and application support: monitoring, fixes, enhancements, admin cover and user help after go-live.
- [Deployment Support](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/ItServices/deployment-support): Environment set-up, release management, DevOps pipelines and go-live support for Salesforce and custom applications.

## Products

- [FUTURA](https://codmsoftware.co.uk/products/futura): FUTURA answers student questions from your own documents and lets admissions staff ask about applicants and enrolments in plain English.
